html: Thucydides' account of the Peloponnesian War, written as it happened and breaking off in 411 BCE. He set out to find the true causes and to write "a possession for all time". Its speeches, such as Pericles' Funeral Oration and the Melian Dialogue, are his reconstructions, and he says so.
